allocation_method: deterministic fingerprint-group heuristic with hard post-allocation integrity validation; no claim of global combinatorial optimality
attack_reserve_rule: optional governance state containing only unavoidable excess pure-attack groups; no benign reserve
family_allocation_rule: deterministic proportional largest-remainder row targets; actual allocation uses indivisible fingerprint groups and records deviations
final_test_sealing_rule: membership/labels/family metadata frozen after integrity gate; final-test feature transformation later is permitted with a benign_weight_train-fitted frozen preprocessor, but final-test influence is forbidden before Notebook 07
lexicographic_priority_order: 3. strict benign majority in development and final test
4. all benign observations used exactly once
5. maximize documented attacks used in development + final test
9. minimize deviations from nominal benign percentages
mixed_label_group_rule: mixed-label groups remain intact and may enter development/final_test only
rare_family_rule: judge independence by fingerprint-group support; one-group families prefer final_test when higher-priority constraints permit; never duplicate/split
tie_breaking_rule: first 64 bits of SHA256(str(PARTITION_SEED) + '|' + feature_fingerprint); full SHA-256 specification is deterministic and Python hash() is never used
